title: Ava asks about Palmer

nodes.speaker: Ava
nodes.text: So you intend to help Captain Vesh?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: So you intend to help Captain Vesh?

nodes.speaker: Ava
nodes.text: Yes. Palmer Vesh is a wanted criminal. A space pirate. Captain of the pirate vessel "Rumor Goose". I thought you knew that.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Yes. Palmer Vesh is a wanted criminal. A space pirate. Captain of the pirate vessel "Rumor Goose". I thought you knew that.

nodes.speaker: Ava
nodes.text: Indeed. I’m glad you pay attention to the morning Holos.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Indeed. I’m glad you pay attention to the morning Holos.

nodes.speaker: Ava
nodes.text: You should pay more attention to the morning Holos.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You should pay more attention to the morning Holos.

nodes.speaker: Ava
nodes.text: Helping Captain Vesh will have repercussions of some kind.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Helping Captain Vesh will have repercussions of some kind.

nodes.speaker: Ava
nodes.text: I’m saying you should consider your position, that's all. It will likely put you on the wrong side of CorpSec.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I’m saying you should consider your position, that's all. It will likely put you on the wrong side of CorpSec.

nodes.speaker: Ava
nodes.text: If we were to act according to the CorpSec public guidelines, then we should inform CorpSec of her whereabouts and presence.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: If we were to act according to the CorpSec public guidelines, then we should inform CorpSec of her whereabouts and presence.

nodes.speaker: Ava
nodes.text: You would no doubt be branded a CorpSec informant if you did.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You would no doubt be branded a CorpSec informant if you did.

nodes.speaker: Ava
nodes.text: They would certainly see you as an ally.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: They would certainly see you as an ally.

nodes.speaker: Ava
nodes.text: As you wish.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: As you wish.

nodes.speaker: Ava
nodes.text: As you wish.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: As you wish.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: "Captain"?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: "Captain"?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I didn't.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I didn't.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I think I read about her.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I think I read about her.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I think I read about her.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I think I read about her.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: You think it's dangerous to help her?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You think it's dangerous to help her?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: You think it's dangerous to help her?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: You think it's dangerous to help her?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: So you’re saying I shouldn’t help?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: So you’re saying I shouldn’t help?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: So you’re saying I shouldn’t help?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: So you’re saying I shouldn’t help?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I can live with that.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I can live with that.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: And the right side would be to rat her out?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: And the right side would be to rat her out?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: And the right side would be to rat her out?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: And the right side would be to rat her out?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I can’t do that.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I can’t do that.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: It would get me some credit with them, huh?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: It would get me some credit with them, huh?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: It would get me some credit with them, huh?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: It would get me some credit with them, huh?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: There's no way I'm helping the 'Sec.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: There's no way I'm helping the 'Sec.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: There's no way I'm helping the 'Sec.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: There's no way I'm helping the 'Sec.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Sometimes, you gotta look out for number one. Go ahead and inform CorpSec.
